quality_rationale: The paper provides an adequately scoped and well-executed experimental comparison of an architectural refinement to an established tracking baseline. Controlled testing on multiple standard datasets and across multiple thresholds provides solid empirical support for the claimed gains.
quality_uncertainty: The manuscript explicitly distinguishes open versus closed tracking environments, noting that reconnection and merging heuristics rely on fixed track counts and are unsuitable for general open systems [Ee6822e79e5bc6372-B0027, Ee6822e79e5bc6372-B0038]. It also notes that comparisons are restricted specifically to ByteTrack [Ee6822e79e5bc6372-B0037, Ee6822e79e5bc6372-B0041].
quality_summary: The paper provides an adequately scoped and well-executed experimental comparison of an architectural refinement to an established tracking baseline. Controlled testing on multiple standard datasets and across multiple thresholds provides solid empirical support for the claimed gains.
quality_concerns: The manuscript reports no statistical significance testing or uncertainty quantification for the claimed performance gains, and several headline improvements are small (e.g., HOTA +1.550, MOTA +1.368 in open systems), leaving the robustness of the reported advantages unestablished.; The evaluation independence of the headline outcome is not established: the manuscript does not report whether the threshold values and heuristic parameters were tuned on the same test benchmarks used to report final results, and no held-out validation or independent calibration is described.; The paper contains a mathematical error in the IoU definition, where the union and intersection terms are reversed in Equation 3, undermining confidence in the methodological rigor of the described architecture.
